result.summary: origin/main had advanced d18f290 commits ahead (ISS-0219/ISS-0220/ISS-0221 fixes) since this branch's last push. git rebase origin/main hit two sequential conflicts, both confined to docs/status/requirement_status.v2.yaml (append-only run-history), which GIT_MERGE.md flags as expected under concurrent multi-host use. Resolved by composing both sides chronologically by `at:` timestamp rather than --ours/--theirs: (1) REQ-072's 'started' entry (20:53:32Z) placed before main's SCOPE-CHANGE/ISS-0220 'done' entry (21:46:14Z); (2) SCOPE-CHANGE entry retained before REQ-072's 'done' entry (22:01:03Z), which was already the chronologically correct order on that side. Verified via git diff origin/main..HEAD -- docs/status/requirement_status.v2.yaml: purely additive, 0 deletions, both sides' full note text intact. Post-rebase mandatory conflict-marker grep across the whole tree (*.yaml/*.md/*.ex/*.exs/*.json) found zero stray markers -- the few grep hits were pre-existing markdown underlines/unrelated files, not rebase artifacts. mix format --check-formatted: clean. mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean. First post-rebase TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 full-suite run surfaced 1 failure: test/docs/requirement_status_invariants_test.exs A9, declared entries: 18 vs actual 19 on disk for requirement_status.v2.yaml -- root-caused to this run's own rebase resolution: both the origin/main side (ISS-0220's SCOPE-CHANGE append) and this branch's side (REQ-072's two appends) each bumped the index's scalar `entries:` field relative to their own base, and the rebase's textual merge of that scalar line preserved only one side's bump, not the sum. This is directly attributable to this run's own conflict resolution, not a pre-existing or unrelated failure, so it was fixed in-branch (index entries: 18 -> 19) and amended into the already-rebased commit rather than filed as an external issue. Re-ran the full suite: 1459/1459 passed (1454 tests + 5 properties), 0 failures, all 4 partitions clean. Pushed feature/WF02-REQ072-20260822; plain push was rejected non-fast-forward (expected -- rebase rewrote commits published at Step 00), republished with --force-with-lease scoped only to this branch, accepted. Opened PR #459, squash-merged with --delete-branch. Local cleanup: checked out main, pulled --ff-only (fast-forward, no-op since merge already advanced local main via the merge commands), local feature branch was already removed by the merge step. Final state verified: git branch --show-current -> main; git log --oneline -1 -> 3feeb3d 'feat: tenant-scoped request context and cross-tenant 404 mechanism [WF02-REQ072-20260822] (#459)'; git status -> clean.
